facts.text: Selected variant: Queen, 72 x 60 in (183 x 152 cm), 6 in (15.2 cm) high.
The mattress combines 100% natural latex with high-density coir; the product page describes a biodegradable latex layer with a pincore structure and coir for firm structural support.
The biodegradable latex layer is described as naturally resilient and supportive, and forms the mattress core.
The product specifications list a firm feel and a tight-top style.
The product comes with a 10-year conditional warranty.
